name: Split Out
category_description: Core node - built-in logic, data or generic API functionality
description: Use the Split Out node to separate a single data item containing a list into multiple items. For example, a list of customers, and you want to split them so that you have an item for each customer

parameters.name: Field to Split Out
parameters.description: Enter the field containing the list you want to separate out into individual items

parameters.name: Include
parameters.description: Select whether and how you want n8n to keep any other fields from the input data with each new individual item
options: No Other Fields: No other fields will be included
All Other Fields: All other fields will be included
Selected Other Fields: Only the selected fields will be included

parameters.name: Disable Dot Notation
parameters.description: By default, n8n enables dot notation to reference child fields in the format parent.child. Use this option to disable dot notation (turned on) or to continue using dot (turned off)

parameters.name: Destination Field Name
parameters.description: Enter the field in the output where the split field contents should go

parameters.name: Include Binary
parameters.description: Choose whether to include binary data from the input in the new output (turned on) or not (turned off)

parameters.name: fieldToSplitOut
parameters.description: The name of the input fields to break out into separate items. Separate multiple field names by commas. For binary data, use $binary.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: Whether to copy any other fields into the new items

parameters.name: fieldsToInclude
parameters.description: Fields in the input items to aggregate together

options.name: disableDotNotation
options.description: Whether to disallow referencing child fields using `parent.child` in the field name

options.name: destinationFieldName
options.description: The field in the output under which to put the split field contents

options.name: includeBinary
options.description: Whether to include the binary data in the new items
